output.review_comment: Cannot approve without seeing the test file. The specific changes (20.0 weight limit, `<` vs `<=` boundary, round-half-up rounding) appear to be reverse-engineered from test cases rather than derived from documented requirements. Please provide: (1) the test file to verify these changes match expected behavior, (2) explanation of where each requirement comes from (spec doc or test?), (3) updated docstring if behavior has changed. This will confirm the changes implement the actual carrier spec and aren't just brittle test-specific patches.
